libraries.jose: signs JWTs (RS256): the GitHub App's for the novels repository and the Google service account's; site-runtime's ./access only verifies Access tokens
libraries.mdast-util-directive: an optional peer of Capsomer's rich editor (its Markdown round trip parses and writes source back; Prelum renders to HTML and never writes Markdown), and the chart check (app/lib/chart-check.client.ts) reads directives with it
libraries.mdast-util-from-markdown: an optional peer of Capsomer's rich editor, and the chart check, as above
libraries.mdast-util-frontmatter: an optional peer of Capsomer's rich editor, as above
libraries.mdast-util-gfm: an optional peer of Capsomer's rich editor, as above
libraries.mdast-util-math: an optional peer of Capsomer's rich editor, as above
libraries.micromark-extension-directive: an optional peer of Capsomer's rich editor, and the chart check, as above
libraries.micromark-extension-frontmatter: an optional peer of Capsomer's rich editor, as above
libraries.micromark-extension-gfm: an optional peer of Capsomer's rich editor, as above
libraries.micromark-extension-math: an optional peer of Capsomer's rich editor, as above

copies.app/lib/novels/layout.ts: kindOf here names a book file's kind from its path (scene, character, outline), not site-api's media kind
copies.app/lib/people.server.ts: kindOf here names a project's kind (site or book), not site-api's media kind
copies.app/lib/sites.server.ts: siteEntry here is Carrel's connection entry for a site (its origin and key from the Worker's secrets, the Search Console property), not site-runtime's public registry entry
copies.public/_headers: not by hand: site-runtime-headers writes it on every build from the registry entry the Worker's set comes from (npm run headers, carrel-desk); committed so the /assets/* cache rule can be read
